name: Toki no Furusato
source:
Main character fails university exams and returns to his home town after long absence. He visits rural house where he used to play with a female childhood friend. He reunites with Sanada Yuriko who is a grown-up lady now. Protagonist is rejoiced, but the hidden truth gradually gets revealed... Can young people really be together?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角大学考试失利，回到阔别已久的家乡。他参观了他曾经和一位儿时女性朋友一起玩耍的乡村房屋。他与现在已经成年的真田百合子重逢。主角欣喜若狂，但隐藏的真相却逐渐被揭开……年轻人真的能在一起吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
